text: Billing. $49.99 every 4 weeks from the day you sign up, one payment per block. If your race isn't a whole number of 4-week blocks away, the last, shorter block costs $12.50 a week. Payments end after your race week. Cancel any time at {cancel_url}; you keep the block you've paid for. Refunds. Full refund within 14 days of your first payment; refunding it ends the plan. Adding another race to this plan later doesn't start a new 14-day window. Later payments aren't refunded, except where the law says otherwise.
